summary: An urgency interim ordinance prohibiting new land uses requires a four-fifths vote of the governing body and takes effect for 45 days initially, extendable by 22 months and 15 days for a maximum of two years.

source.citation: Hoodline and Contra Costa News, September 2026, citing the statute

notes: Explains why California data center moratoria adopted in 2026 are uniformly 45 days at first reading. Richmond staff are reported to intend returning within the 45-day period to seek the extension, so the initial term understates the instrument's reach.
confidence_note: Statute not read in original. The extension structure is carried from two secondary accounts and the precise sequence of extensions has not been verified against the code text.
